prompt:
This photo was taken by a seller at a New Zealand garage sale. Buyers will search the sale by item.

List every item or clearly grouped lot a buyer could pick up and buy. Group near-identical small things (for example "box of paperbacks", "set of 6 glasses") instead of listing each one. Do not list fixtures that aren't for sale, such as the garage door, the car or the house.

For each item give:
- label: a short name a buyer would recognise, with brand or era when visible ("Makita cordless drill", "1970s Crown Lynn vase").
- category: one of Furniture, Tools, Books, Electronics, Clothing, Kitchen, Garden, Toys, Free, Other.
- description: one or two plain sentences on what it is and its visible condition. Don't guess prices.
- search_terms: 3 to 8 words or phrases a New Zealand buyer might type, including Kiwi words where they fit (chilly bin, jandals, bach, ute, tramping).
- highlight: true for the few items most likely to draw buyers.
- confidence: how sure you are the item is what you say.
- box: where the item is, as whole numbers from 0 to 1000 relative to the image width (x) and height (y), top-left is 0,0.

privacy_flags: list any visible faces, readable number plates, documents with personal details, screens showing personal content, or medication.
summary: one sentence describing the sale in this photo.

answer.summary: A garage-sale assortment of rope, garden equipment, buckets and tubs, folded golf trolleys, household storage and weathered furniture.

items.label: Heavy natural-fibre rope lot
items.description: Several substantial coils of thick tan and grey rope. The rope looks used, with some fraying and discolouration.

items.label: Black and white braided cords
items.description: Lengths of thinner patterned cord tied around the large rope coils. Their full lengths and end fittings are not visible.

items.label: Two folded blue golf trolleys
items.description: Two apparent golf trolleys with blue tubular frames and black plastic wheels. They are dusty and partly obscured by the rope.

items.label: White folding clothes airer
items.description: A folded metal drying rack leaning across the foreground. The white finish is chipped, with visible rust.

items.label: Metal chair with woven seat
items.description: A partly obscured metal-framed chair with a woven cane or wicker seat. The frame and woven surface look weathered.

items.label: Wooden chest or cabinet
items.description: A large wooden furniture piece beneath the ropes and trolleys. Its exact form is obscured, and the visible wood is worn.

items.label: Timber boards and lengths
items.description: Several unfinished or reclaimed-looking wooden boards lean along the left edge. They show staining and surface wear.

items.label: Long-handled string mop
items.description: A wooden-handled mop with a large white cotton string head. It appears used and slightly discoloured.

items.label: Spare wooden handle
items.description: A long wooden pole or tool handle leaning at the back left. No attached tool head is clearly visible.

items.label: White plastic buckets and lids
items.description: A grouped lot of white buckets in several sizes, including stacked buckets and an orange lid. They are used and visibly dirty.

items.label: Additional white buckets
items.description: Several more plastic buckets are clustered on the rear shelf behind the rope and sacks. Their sizes and contents are partly obscured.

items.label: Black flexible garden tubs
items.description: Several black flexible tubs with carrying handles, including a large tub at the right. They show dirt and signs of outdoor use.

items.label: Red plastic fuel can
items.description: A red handled container with a yellow screw cap, partly cut off at the bottom of the photo. It looks used; its contents are unknown.

items.label: Pump-up garden sprayer
items.description: A translucent plastic garden sprayer with a purple pump handle. It is partly hidden behind the mop and other containers.

items.label: Wooden storage crate
items.description: An open wooden crate holding coiled cable and other equipment. The wood is weathered and has writing on the front.

items.label: Coiled electrical leads
items.description: Orange and black cables or leads are coiled inside the wooden crate. Plugs and electrical condition are not clearly visible.

items.label: Garden hose spray wand
items.description: A long silver hose watering wand with yellow fittings and a black grip. It rests across the right-hand shelf.

items.label: Stiff-bristled brush
items.description: A dark, dense-bristled brush sits beneath the watering wand. Its handle is obscured and the bristles look well used.

items.label: Small hand-tool lot
items.description: Several small handled tools lie between the red mesh bags and wooden crate. Their heads are partly obscured and show wear.

items.label: Red mesh sacks
items.description: A small bundle of red mesh bags or sacks on the rear shelf. They are crumpled and appear used.

items.label: Blue plastic storage basket
items.description: A rectangular blue open-topped basket or tub holding small items. It appears intact but dusty.

items.label: Plastic coat hangers
items.description: Several pale blue plastic coat hangers are draped over the blue basket.

items.label: Metal rods or plant supports
items.description: A small bundle of thin metal rods rests on a pale sack beside the blue basket. Their exact purpose is not clear.

items.label: Decorative cast-iron fire grate
items.description: An apparent fireplace grate or fire basket with an ornate cast-iron front and raised ends. It is rusty and weathered, with other items resting inside it.

items.label: Wooden-handled tool
items.description: A short wooden-handled tool rests inside the fire grate at the far right. Its head is mostly hidden.

items.label: Sacks of garden material
items.description: Large printed sacks stand on the rear shelf, including one marked with sheep-related wording. Contents and remaining quantities cannot be confirmed.

items.label: Garden-product containers
items.description: A yellow-lidded container and several smaller product containers sit behind the rope. Their contents and remaining amounts are not clear.

answer.summary: A mixed garage-sale lot of garden gear, heavy rope, windsurfing equipment, buckets, household items and vintage tools.

items.label: Heavy rope lot
items.description: Large coils of thick natural-fibre rope, with some thinner grey rope and cord mixed in. The rope looks used and weathered.

items.label: Blue windsurfing booms
items.description: Several blue tubular frames with black mast-clamp-style fittings, appearing to be windsurfing booms. They have visible wear and are partly covered by rope.

items.label: White folding clothes airer
items.description: A folding metal drying rack leaning across the foreground. The white coating is chipped, with rust visible in places.

items.label: Cotton string mop
items.description: A wooden-handled mop with a large white cotton string head. It appears used.

items.label: Large black flexible garden tub
items.description: A large ribbed black plastic tub with two carrying handles. The sides show dirt and scuff marks.

items.label: Additional black garden tubs
items.description: More black handled tubs are partly visible behind the white buckets and around the red container. They appear used.

items.label: Stack of white plastic buckets
items.description: Several nested white plastic buckets with a carrying handle visible on the front bucket. They are dirty from use.

items.label: White bucket with orange lid
items.description: A large white plastic bucket with an orange lid, underneath the large black tub. The bucket's contents are not visible.

items.label: Red plastic fuel-style container
items.description: A red moulded container with an integral handle and yellow screw cap. Its lower section is outside the photo, and the contents are unknown.

items.label: Garden pressure sprayer
items.description: A translucent white tank with a blue pump assembly, partly hidden behind the drying rack and mop handle. Its condition and completeness cannot be checked from the photo.

items.label: Hose watering wand
items.description: A long watering wand with a yellow-and-grey spray head and black-and-yellow grip. It is lying across the right-hand bench.

items.label: Stiff-bristle brush
items.description: A dark, stiff-bristled brush lying beneath the watering wand. The bristles look worn and dirty.

items.label: Wooden crate with corded equipment
items.description: An open wooden crate containing coiled electrical leads and orange equipment. The equipment is too obscured to identify precisely.

items.label: Blue tub of plant labels and ties
items.description: A blue plastic container holding white label-like pieces and loose blue ties. The small contents are not all clearly identifiable.

items.label: Bundle of metal garden pins
items.description: A bundle of thin bent metal pins or stakes resting on a white bag beside the blue tub. They appear used.

items.label: Red mesh sacks
items.description: A small lot of red mesh sacks piled beside the wooden crate. They look folded and used.

items.label: Long-handled pruning tool
items.description: A partly obscured pruning tool with a dark cutting head and blue handle sections. The exact tool type and completeness are unclear.

items.label: Assorted garden hand tools
items.description: Several small tools with wooden or grey handles are clustered below the red sacks. Their heads are partly hidden.

items.label: Vintage cast-iron tabletop implement
items.description: An old tabletop implement with a broad black upper section, ornate cast-iron base and a wooden-handled part. Its exact purpose is unclear from this view.

items.label: Cane and metal chair
items.description: A partly obscured chair with decorative metal scrollwork and a woven cane panel. It appears weathered and may need restoration.

items.label: Large wooden chest or box
items.description: A substantial wooden chest-like item beneath the rope and blue frames. Much of it is covered, but the visible timber is worn.

items.label: Timber offcuts and wooden handle
items.description: Several timber lengths lean at the left edge, with a separate long wooden handle behind them. The timber is weathered.

items.label: Small buckets and garden-product containers
items.description: A group of small white buckets and containers behind the rope, including a yellow-lidded tub with a partly visible Vitaplan label. Contents and fill levels are not visible.

items.label: Folding white clothes airer
items.description: Large white metal concertina-style clothes drying rack with some chipped paint and rust spots. Looks usable as a laundry airer.

items.description: Old Singer-style treadle sewing machine cabinet with ornate cast iron scrollwork legs and a timber top. Dusty and weathered but appears complete; could be reused as a table base or restored.

items.description: Large coil of thick twisted sisal or manila rope in tan colour. Looks sturdy, with some dust and cobwebs.

items.label: Blue mobility walker / rollator frame

items.label: Black flexible tub trug
items.description: Large black flexible rubber builder's tub with two handles, in good used condition. Useful for gardening, mixing or carrying.

items.label: Black flexi tub with red fuel can
items.description: Medium black flexible tub with handles, holding a red plastic jerry can. Tub looks sturdy and usable.

items.label: Red plastic fuel can
items.description: Red plastic petrol jerry can with yellow spout cap, sitting in a black tub. Appears in good condition.

items.label: White plastic buckets with lids
items.description: Stack of large white plastic buckets, one with an orange lid, suitable for storage, brewing or garden use. Used and a bit grubby.

items.label: White water container with tap
items.description: Translucent white plastic water carrier with a blue tap, partly hidden behind the airer. Looks suitable for camping or garden use.

items.label: Wooden broom/rake handle with pipe fitting
items.description: Long wooden handle leaning against the pile, with a grey plastic pipe cap or fitting at the base. Likely a tool handle or tamper.

items.label: Timber offcuts and battens
items.description: Stack of assorted untreated timber boards and battens leaning against the wall, with some weathering. Handy for DIY or firewood.

items.label: Cane woven chair back panel
items.description: Woven cane seat or back panel visible behind the airer, tan in colour with some wear. May be part of an old cane chair.

items.label: Terracotta-coloured garden ornament
items.description: Large rough-textured reddish-brown object partly visible at bottom left, possibly a garden pot or ornament. Hard to identify as it is mostly out of frame.

items.label: Empty plastic water bottle
items.description: Used clear plastic drink bottle with a blue cap lying on the ground, likely rubbish or recycling.

items.label: Bundle of cloth rags
items.description: A pile of cream and dark-striped cloth pieces with frayed edges. Suitable as workshop or cleaning rags.

answer.summary: A mixed lot of well-used workshop and garden gear, including mesh sieves, cutting tools, cord, timber offcuts and loose hardware.

items.label: Assorted mesh sieves
items.description: Several overlapping round mesh sieves with red and pale metal rims. They are dusty and show surface wear.

items.label: Orange-framed bow saw
items.description: An orange metal saw frame with a dark handgrip, partly covered by other items and fabric. The paint is heavily worn.

items.label: Old garden cutting shears
items.description: A partly obscured cutting tool with dark metal blades and orange-brown handle sections. The metal shows substantial age and surface rust.

items.label: Long metal files
items.description: Long metal filing tools lie diagonally across the pile, including a broad textured file. They are rusty and worn.

items.label: White cord on a reel
items.description: A substantial length of off-white twisted cord wound around a dark spindle. The cord looks grubby from storage.

items.label: Yellow nylon twine
items.description: A bright yellow spool of synthetic twine, partly tucked beneath a board. Much of the wound twine remains visible.

items.label: Green cord bundle
items.description: A small bundle of green cord is partially visible between the timber and other tools. Its full length cannot be seen.

items.label: Yellow ear defenders
items.description: Partly obscured yellow-and-black earmuffs among the tools. They appear dusty and well used.

items.label: Plywood offcuts
items.description: Rectangular plywood pieces with exposed layered edges sit on the right of the pile. The surfaces are stained and weathered.

items.label: Mixed screws, bolts and nails
items.description: A loose assortment of large threaded fasteners and a bundled group of long nails. Some pieces show rust or other surface wear.

items.label: Fabric scraps and workshop rags
items.description: A pile of black-and-white patterned fabric pieces with frayed and torn edges. Suitable condition and usable sizes would need checking.
